offers_products.reason: Manufactures filtration systems, valves, submarine dampening tiles, grid test equipment (Doble, Megger) and RF shielding/test chambers.

offers_services.reason: Doble offers grid diagnostic testing, monitoring and expert support services alongside equipment, though products are larger.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to aerospace manufacturers, U.S./U.K. Navy, electric utilities, and wireless and electronics companies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Aftermarket parts, utility test software and services, and long-running defense programs give repeat orders, though test chambers are project-based.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand rests on defense programs, aerospace aftermarket and utility grid reliability, which are less postponable, though RF test chambers are more discretionary.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly components, valves, filters and test instruments; only RF test chambers and Navy systems are large.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes mainly from engineered, manufactured products and technology, not from staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are the Navy, large aerospace primes, big electric utilities and major electronics firms.

asset_heavy.reason: Precision manufacturing needs plants, but it is moderate and not heavy like utilities or fleets.
